## Body

#320 F268 round 1 is in progress at exact head 5c219c0b34c1f2e3e2253e68bbf96f8fca1a9631 (review-320-5c219c0). No verdict yet. Request to answer: 01a1fdf6-2810-75a2-9424-ff17e0f4fa2b. Product checkout remains read-only; do not trigger receiver lapses/renewals on live seats.

Confirmed: follow_lapses_every attaches before reconciling, consumes until a gap, waits until the last completed reconcile plus the minimum interval, then attaches before another durable reconcile. Shutdown aborts and joins the extension_lost task, so cancellation of a pending sleep is owned externally; do not assume the lack of an inner stop select alone proves a hang.

New investigation to preserve: update_native_receiver returns held bodies before telling renewed, then re-inserts native_lapsed if that spine write failed. The same set suppresses repeated lapse-edge publication in reconcile_native_receivers. Existing coverage proves only that the next heartbeat eventually writes renewed.

Next isolated probes must cover two intervening windows: (1) auth-recovery reconciliation immediately after an unrecorded renewal, before the next heartbeat, while the mechanical receiver is already live; (2) a genuine second lease expiry before that retry, when the reinserted mark may suppress a fresh lapse edge. These are candidates, not confirmed findings. New held-decision events make producer/consumer sequence correlation especially important.

Performance independently pointed out the same first window: normal heartbeat retry is about twenty seconds while gap reconciliation may happen after ten. Do not equate eventual retry with immediately current persistence; begin with an undecided or dropped lapse.

Verified lapse_held handling: outstanding reads the latest lapsed/renewed/acting/held event; remembered reads acting recovery only, so a held record does not move the thirty-minute window. Test restart plus a later real lapse, and retain the lost-renewal and held-body-return positive controls.

Prior F261 final and F260 identity notes were read. Next proof should use the existing private fake/real-SQLite test fixtures, not live seats. All builds through shared-build, nice 19, canonical target; clean only named paths created by this review.
